title: Fiji Registrar of Companies Search Scraper

query.title: Entity number or entity name
query.description: A single ROC entity number (e.g. 10658) or entity/business name (e.g. Vodafone Fiji) to search for. Which field it is sent as is controlled by 'Search by'.

queries.title: Entity numbers or entity names
queries.description: Multiple entity numbers/names to search for in one run. Combined with 'query' if both are set.

searchBy.title: Search by
searchBy.description: Entity number search does a reliable substring match on ROC's EntityNumber field. Entity name search is UNRELIABLE on this upstream site -- it performs a loose fuzzy/phonetic match, not a name-contains match, and can return thousands of loosely-related entities even for an exact company name (a confirmed upstream quirk, not a bug in this actor). Prefer entity number when you have it.

maxResultsPerQuery.title: Max results per query
maxResultsPerQuery.description: Maximum number of matched entities to return per search query.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent workers
maxConcurrency.description: How many search sessions to run in parallel.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy configuration. Residential is on by default.
